verdict.rationale: Vanta's SDK docs say its official SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI specification, and the API reference has an interactive server selector, so a machine-readable spec appears to exist. However, no evidence shows it is published for download, and probes of the usual spec URLs (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public download URL for the OpenAPI spec, confirmation of which APIs it covers (Manage Vanta API as well as the Auditor API), and hands-on verification of retrieval.
